nodes.label: Liquidity/volatility ranking
nodes.rationale: Pool-relative percentile weights are day volume 15, 63-session volume 10, 20-session volume 10, day RVOL 20, inverse spread 15, positive beta 10 and ATR% 20. Missing/stale metrics receive zero without redistribution. Discovery ranks a bounded 500-symbol pool; radar ranks its own set.

nodes.label: Separate day, session and minute volume provenance
nodes.rationale: Provider daily aggregates include eligible extended-hours volume; session volume uses completed regular minutes. Partial extended-minute fallback never adds to an aggregate. Fallback freshness checks both receipt and minute end within 120 seconds; discovery daily aggregates instead allow 300-second receipt age.

nodes.label: Complete-history and freshness alert gates
nodes.rationale: Missing regular-session minutes cannot be assumed zero. Alerts require complete opening coverage, exact prior-30-session history, 21 contiguous minutes, fresh trades/quotes and volume, regular trading and technical guards. Only new completed ordinary minute bars advance confirmation.

nodes.label: Observed 5/15/30-minute alert outcomes
nodes.rationale: Journal outcomes use the completed signal minute close and contiguous future bars with exact symbol/source/feed/session identity. Corrections may revise observations without rewriting original alerts. These price changes simulate neither fills nor portfolio returns.

nodes.label: Nasdaq Trader stocks-only classification
nodes.rationale: Real discovery, daily Alpaca/CSV screening and live selections require verified common/ordinary stocks or depositary shares from Nasdaq Trader directories. Ambiguous instruments are excluded, the cache lasts one hour and refresh failure blocks screening. SPY remains benchmark-only.

nodes.label: Daily screener score
nodes.rationale: Requires 201 valid daily bars. Scores combine trend 35, momentum 25, volume 20, aligned SPY relative strength 15 and prior-high proximity 5. Missing benchmark data earns zero; filters generally use unrounded values. The score is a heuristic ranking.
